commands.name: incremental mutation compatibility

commands.command: cmd /c "findstr /C:actions/checkout@v7 .github\workflows\ci.yml >NUL && findstr /C:actions/setup-node@v7 .github\workflows\ci.yml >NUL && echo CI actions at v7"

commands.command: cmd /c "findstr /C:remediated docs\plan-evidence.md >NUL && echo plan-evidence blocking gate recorded"
